mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and increases present value of future earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls by at least 0.25% per month for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months combined with a decline in average weekly hours worked (HOUST) signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5% for two consecutive months AND HOUST falls for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters AND HOUST falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, except during periods of monetary easing (FEDFUNDS falling for three consecutive months).
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5% for two consecutive months AND FEDFUNDS not falling for three consecutive months
regime_hint: labor market weakening outside monetary easing
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05).
